description: Source code for handling LHA archive operations including listing, testing, extracting, adding, and deleting files, with functions for parsing output and checking program type.

methods.name: xa_lha_check_program
methods.description: Checks if the program at the given path is a full Lhasa program.

methods.name: xa_lha_ask
methods.description: Configures archive capabilities based on archive type and read-only status.

methods.name: xa_lha_parse_output
methods.description: Parses a line of output from the lha listing command to extract file info.

methods.name: xa_lha_list
methods.description: Lists contents of an archive by executing the lha list command and parsing output.

methods.name: xa_lha_test
methods.description: Tests the integrity of an archive using the lha test command.

methods.name: xa_lha_extract
methods.description: Extracts files from an archive using the lha extract command.

methods.name: xa_lha_add
methods.description: Adds files to an archive using the lha add command.

methods.name: xa_lha_delete
methods.description: Deletes files from an archive using the lha delete command.
